selection: smallest best validation MSE, tie trial_id ascending; never test
oom_rule: Dry-run all first 9 independently at batch64 before screening; replace OOM candidates with next pre-shuffled candidate, unchanged batch. If original OOM stop and reconsider all-family batch; record all excluded configs.
failure_rule: nonfinite trial recorded as failed, never silently dropped; continue others; failed trials are not budget replacements unless setup or code defect precedes training
reuse: screen requires exact 19AC/20epoch protocol; final historical checkpoint only if all parameters/split/seed/training protocol/source match. Otherwise rerun.
scarce: fixed 19 of 57 AC (33.3%) linspace full intensity coverage with all 2400 training GMs; tune selected configs trained 50 epochs and evaluate all 57AC fixed test, chosen by equal intensity coverage not previous results
transfer: selected FNO/Transformer at20Hz resample_poly(up2,down5) same splits/full57AC/50epochs; same-grid20 + direct50 + wrapped50
framework_variation: GPU hardware/runtime are recorded per trial; candidate_count/epochs are controlled, not FLOPs or GPU hours. Other three baseline families retain original configurations.
